newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SNB not tightening now but remains vigil.
newsitem.headline: SNB not tightening now but remains vigil.

text.p: Swiss National Bank (SNB) chairman Hans Meyer said it was too soon in the Swiss recovery to tighten domestic monetary policy, but the SNB remains alert and will act when needed.

"The chances for a gradual economic recovery with a high degree of price stability are still intact. Sooner or later we will have to once again tighten the monetary policy reins, in order not to endanger price stability. But things are still not so far along," Meyer said in the text of a speech to be delivered at the SNB's annual shareholders' meeting.
